title: Cleaner profile input setup
summary: This release makes live wheel mappings easier to configure and adds a guided clutch-axis binding flow.
highlights: The profile editor now opens directly on virtual buttons, with search and input tabs taking priority over repeated headings.
Class defaults have their own tab so button, clutch, system-action, and automatic-selection settings are easier to find.
A three-step walkthrough explains how to bind Pivot's persistent vJoy clutch axis once in LMU.
Combined clutch axes now pass through the value produced by SimPro, SimHub, or wheel firmware; no artificial bite-point processing is added.
Disable remapping and Resume auto remain available as global controls while routing is live.
